name: 4-seater rope garden furniture set
material: powder coated steel frame w/t weavn rope rounded, polyester fabric cushion, coffee table w/t 5mm thick black silk screen printing glass
description: Sunburst garden furniture allows you to furnish your patio and create a tranquil corner to relax in during the summer. It can accommodate up to four people around a coffee table with two armchairs and a two-seater sofa. The seats offer comfortable seating thanks to their armrests and soft seat and back cushions. This garden furniture set adds style to your patio with its solid and durable black steel frame and rope covering that lends a natural touch to the outdoor décor
